en: Colorized vintage postcard showing a mounted soldier in parade uniform. The rider wears an elaborate blue and white hussar-style uniform with tall boots, a shako-style hat, and carries a lance with a small flag. He sits on a brown horse in a park-like landscape with trees and grass. Red printed titles at the top read "Torgau." and "In Parade." Additional fine print at the bottom credits the publisher and notes that it is a hand-colored artist card dated 1906.
